terms.definition: A ratio or fraction expressed out of a hundred, written with a % sign.
terms.whereItIs: The number label beside the percent grid.
terms.whyItMatters: The out-of-100 scale makes different amounts easy to compare.

terms.definition: A 10-by-10 grid of 100 squares where each square is one percent.
terms.whereItIs: The square grid in the scene.
terms.whyItMatters: It makes percent a visible quantity rather than a code.

terms.definition: A percent written as a fraction with denominator 100.
terms.whereItIs: The fraction card beside the grid.
terms.whyItMatters: It shows that percent is really just a fraction.

terms.definition: A percent written as a decimal, dividing by 100.
terms.whereItIs: The decimal card beside the grid.
terms.whyItMatters: Decimals let you compute 'percent of' amounts by multiplying.

terms.definition: The whole — all 100 out of every 100.
terms.function: Represents the entire amount being described.
terms.whereItIs: When the whole grid lights up.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the reference point that defines all other percents.
